answer: For race outcomes, an oracle demands a quorum of independent timing officials: at least three accredited timekeepers must attest the same finishing order, each signing the result from the cold tundra of the finish line to the federation's archive. A single Sybil cannot mint fake winners because the quorum needs distinct accredited keys, and a relic of an old photo-finish still decides ties, with every thread of the timing record cross-checked.
